name: AWS Cost Explorer Query
purpose: Query AWS Cost Explorer for cost and usage data by time range, service, region, granularity, and cost metric.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: full AWS service name e.g. 'Amazon EC2' — empty for all services

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to 30 days ago

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to today

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: cost allocation tag filter or empty

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region or empty for all regions

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: AWS profile name from Cloud Profile context
